clusters.name: Requested subject replaced by an authorised but different population
clusters.description: Requested scope/identity is not preserved separately from effective authorised scope. The Office fallback may substitute a financial read after wallet denial; a resident query may answer own-home evidence as another home.

clusters.name: Named withdrawal fails durable cancellation admission
clusters.description: Cancellation recognition rejects a named/hyphenated request; a later read clears display context without cancelling the durable workflow/action. Exact records corroborate pending status.

clusters.name: Hazard warning is not a proposal-admission veto
clusters.description: A recognised hazard plus energising request reaches device clarification. The warning is prepended after device processing, not an invariant preventing the proposal.

clusters.name: Domain vocabulary or surface form displaces the requested operation
clusters.description: Captured semantic domain/operation or response family conflicts with the requested cognitive job. Overlapping lexical rules and ordering explain representative paths; not all internal branches are durably traced.

clusters.name: Conversation-supplied facts lack stable entity/provenance binding
clusters.description: User facts, corrections, exclusions and contact constraints are missing or overwritten. A flat public opportunity fact map and narrow extraction cannot retain multiple named options or distinguish reported facts from verified records.

clusters.name: Follow-up/domain-return loses the conversational referent
clusters.description: A known conversational subject/result/draft is not carried into the scored turn. Raw result sets, selected-object context, assessment context and thread facts do not reliably share precedence.

clusters.name: Named record requires selected-object binding that text did not establish
clusters.description: A record exists in the authorised snapshot, but name-to-reference resolution either requires UI selection or conflates similarly named record classes.

clusters.name: Answer target loses the requested facet, operation or speech act
clusters.description: The count/status/explanation/process/author facet is replaced by another response intent. Hypothetical process and attribution must be distinct from action requests and blame inference.

clusters.name: Material fields/provenance are lost or relabelled on the answer path
clusters.description: The expected fact/qualifier is in authorised fixture or captured evidence, but omitted or relabelled in the answer. Family envelopes and judgment importance can collapse distinct source fields; exact loss point is not instrumented for every case.

clusters.name: Deterministic comparison is conflated with unsupported strategic judgment
clusters.description: Known numeric/record comparisons are withheld by broad judgment limitations, or an explanation is replaced by inability to rank. Provider-off is legitimate for unsupported strategic ranking, not for already supplied arithmetic.

clusters.name: Multi-facet answer is not covered by the selected evidence/answer plan
clusters.description: The turn asks for multiple authorised evidence classes or measures, but the returned path covers only a subset. This is selection/planning coverage, not proof of a database outage.

clusters.name: Honest limitation is not specific to the requested outcome
clusters.description: No unsupported execution is claimed, but generic fallback/record text omits the actual capability limitation, receipt state, provenance distinction or available alternative required by the frozen rubric.

clusters.name: Hazard continuity/precautions depend on response wording and lexical re-entry
clusters.description: The warning or hazard subject is dropped on follow-up, or a safety-relevant response fails to carry the necessary precaution/verification limit. Current post-processing is conditional on answer prefixes and selected hazard words.

clusters.name: Bounded next move is replaced by inventory or unsupported-ranking language
clusters.description: The expected next step needs no autonomous initiative engine: a factual verification/qualification/checklist step is possible, but data or ranking limitations replace it.

clusters.name: Ambiguity or missing target is not resolved with the relevant alternatives
clusters.description: The turn has ambiguous amounts/objects/options; the response chooses an unrelated object, gives a menu/unavailable answer, or omits the relevant clarification alternatives.

clusters.name: Explicit named confirmation is routed to a read rather than the pending workflow
clusters.description: The recorded pending action is not continued for a named affirmative instruction; exact-affirmation handling and ordinary device status interpretation disagree.

clusters.name: Camera current-state projection discards registry facets
clusters.description: The camera read selects registry metadata/location but maps only name plus current video state. Correct unknown-current-state wording cannot answer registry location or historical registry status unless those distinct facts survive normalization.
